about: Procedural cliff rock for Ariel's mansion (tools/ariel-home/gen_cliff_textures.py). Tileable 3 m x 3 m sets; mesh UVs are true surface metres / tileM, so 1 UV unit = 3 m.

uv.u: world x metres / tileM along the wall
uv.v: metres up the wall / tileM (Blender v up; glTF v is flipped, load with flipY=false); image row 0 = top = up the cliff
uv.note: meshes: Mansion_LOD0 prims ah_rock / ah_rockc / ah_rocks / ah_rockt carry COLOR_0 = macro tint (multiply into albedo) and NORMAL; tangents are derived from the UVs

channels.color: sRGB albedo, already flattened at tile scale; multiply by COLOR_0
channels.nrm: tangent-space normal, OpenGL (+Y = up the wall), RGB 8-bit, linear
channels.orm: linear: R ambient occlusion, G roughness, B metalness (0)
channels.height: 8-bit gray, linear, 1 = proud, 0 = deepest; for parallax occlusion: depth = (1 - h) * depthM below the surface plane

parallax.note: use heightmap tier of the loaded albedo tier; skip POM on the 512 tier / mobile if the frame budget is tight

use.strata: ledged beds on the main wall
use.sheet: granite sheeting on the flanks + plateau pavement
